# Municipal Court Judge Samantha Silverstein

![honorable-samantha-silverstein-sm](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/wp-content/uploads//2023/11/honorable-samantha-silverstein.jpg)

## Honorable Samantha Silverstein

Hamilton County Courthouse

1000 Main Street

Room 280

Cincinnati, Ohio 45202

Ashley Harp, Bailiff

Phone Number: 513-946-5138

Fax: 513-946-5140

## About Judge Silverstein

Judge Silverstein was elected to the Hamilton County Municipal Court bench on November 7, 2023.  Judge Silverstein graduated from DePaul College of Law in 2013. During law school she clerked at the Cook County Public Defender's Office and was a student in the Center for Justice In Capital Cases. After graduation, she joined the public defender's office in West Palm Beach, Florida. In West Palm, she worked in the misdemeanor, juvenile, and felony divisions. She tried over 40 jury trials. In 2017, Judge Silverstein moved to Cincinnati to be closer to family. Before joining the public defender's office, she worked at Legal Aid for Southwest Ohio in the Child Law, Family Law, and Housing Law practice divisions. Before attending law school, Judge Silverstein was a journalism and political science student at Indiana University Bloomington.

Education:

Juris Doctor, DePaul University College of Law, 2013. Bachelor of Arts, Indiana University Bloomington, 2010.

Bar Admissions:

2019 Ohio, 2013 Florida
